settings.heading: About Excellent Tiling Services
settings.text: Tiles, bathroomware and tiling work from our showroom in Maddington, Perth. Trading since 2011.

settings.heading: Our story
settings.text:
Excellent Tiling Services is a Perth tiling business based in Maddington. We've been trading since 2011. We do residential tiling for renovations and new builds: bathrooms, wet areas, floors, walls and splashbacks.

We also sell bathroom products from our showroom at 17A Olga Road, Maddington, and online. That includes vanities, basins, tapware, baths, toilets, mirrors, shower screens and accessories. So if you're doing a bathroom, you can buy the products and get the tiling done by the same people.
